scripts.build:public: npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs-extra'); fs.ensureDir('public').then(() => Promise.all(['assets', 'css', 'dist', 'index.html'].filter(f => fs.existsSync(f)).map((f) => fs.copy(f, 'public/' + f)))).then(() => console.log('✅ Successfully!'));"
scripts.deploy: npm run build:public && cd public && git init && git add . && git commit -m 'Deploy' && git branch -M gh-pages && git remote add origin https://github.com/ocim128/undangan.git && git push -f origin gh-pages
